title: Unit Event — With Our Wounded Hands — Episode5 Solidarity

meta.Event Outline: Ena hasn't been able to reach Mizuki since the school festival. She doesn't know what the right thing to do is, but her regrets compel her to seek Mizuki out for a heart-to-heart.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What brings you all here today?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: The new demo's finished, so we were hoping to listen to it with you and the others, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh, really...?
I can't wait to hear what it's like.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: No, still too busy it seems.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I tried going everywhere I thought Mizuki would be multiple times since then...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Has Mizuki just been at home this whole time...?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Asking Shiraishi to help is sorta my last resort, but I don't think I have a choice at this point...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You've been like this ever since Mizuki stopped showing up.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I can't tell you guys much, but...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Is there anything I can do to help?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But it must be serious if it's causing you so much distress, Ena.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So, I'd like to help if I can.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Because you and Mizuki are both valued members of N25...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'd like to help as well...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Because Mizuki never showing up again would be a problem.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I am somewhat responsible for what happened, after all.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We'd like to help as well.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: In that case, would you all mind helping me find Mizuki?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I want us to talk, but my calls and messages have all gone unanswered...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But do you have a search plan?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I mean, Mizuki hasn't replied at all, right?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I can possibly try getting a hold of Mizuki through a friend at school.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But if that doesn't go well, it might end up making things worse...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Then, why don't we go to the places where we'd normally find Mizuki...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, I guess that's our only option...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But that's gonna be hard since it's a lot of ground to cover...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I have everyone's help this time. I'm not alone.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Thanks for doing this, you two...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
No...
I was hoping going to the sewing lounge would help since Mizuki seems to spend a lot of time there.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Then, Kanade, do you know if there are any fabric shops around here?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Fabric shops? I'm not sure.
I can try doing a quick search...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Mizuki's been wanting to go to this new one since it's supposed to be really cute.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Then, I'll try finding what I can on it...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: This seemed like the right time to catch everyone going home, but I have no way of telling if Mizuki's even at school.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, it has.
Are you waiting for someone?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Yes, actually...
I was in the neighborhood and hoping to see Mizuki...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Unfortunately, Akiyama wasn't at school today...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I see...
Thank you for letting me know.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Actually, Aoyagi, there's something I'd like to ask you...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I was so sure this company's latest release would be the perfect draw.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (No, I might just need to wait.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (At least until the evening. That could be my chance...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(But if we don't see each other...
Then that means Mizuki's all alone somewhere...)
